TRANSCODED_VIDEO refers to videos transcoded by Campaign Manager from PARENT_VIDEO assets and is applicable to INSTREAM_VIDEO and VPAID_LINEAR_VIDEO creatives. ALTERNATE_VIDEO refers to the Campaign Manager representation of child asset videos from Studio, and is applicable to VPAID_LINEAR_VIDEO creatives. PARENT_AUDIO refers to audios uploaded by the user in Campaign Manager and is applicable to INSTREAM_AUDIO creatives.
